cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your dragon can stay for tea. Brush those biscuit crumbs off the carpet; I spent long enough teaching you to set a proper table.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His three heads breathe fire. Shall I take him outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He's fine. Three mouths, though? Three napkins, quickly. You used to count the chairs and forget who was sitting in them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own napkins. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen before the neighbours see. I was just beginning to trust you with guests.
